executed_player_authorization: Shiki accepts Izumi field reconnaissance operation and travels to Kusa border Ivovy Brod post, reaches northern watchtower. He has not chosen specific approach, chakra technique, spy disguise, squad command, aggression, thoughts or speech besides acceptance.

events.visible: Shiki says 'Пойду в полевую разведку'. Izumi ratifies legal order: discreet surveillance and medical cargo assessment inside Kusa; lawful customs search if grounded; no arbitrary detention or crossing national border. She cautions that factual evidence is needed, not dead bodies.

Shiki arrives Kusa-side by normal transfer/travel after accepted assignment. Local border surveillance Chunin Nagase Jun, stocky ~30 with scarred left ear, provides observation platform, outpost map. View of road ~60m, inspection court 24m, second outpost on south bank under commander, not automatically Jun command. Jun wary of headquarters inspectors but loyal to his patrol, insists his people know terrain. No active chakra use by Shiki.

Licensed trade convoy 'Северный тростник' arrives in rainy low visibility: 3 covered wagons, SIX escorts, THREE drivers, ONE woman documents/medical escort. Two horses pull wagon1 and wagon3, FOUR pull wagon2; wagon2 wheels sink deeper, may be heavier for various legitimate reasons. Two guards at wagon2 coordinate observation sectors with training; visible but no weapons drawn. Firm logo on gray green canvas.

Woman ~30 dark short hair, raincoat, no shinobi protector, presents fire country medical transit documents and distinct Konoha-marked approval sheet. Verification of stamp/authority NOT yet done. Customs clerk confirms four sealed medical containers declared, asks location of fourth. Woman looks toward wagon2, says temperature-sensitive requires med specialist. Local official says medic available and requests certificate.

Shiki and Jun from ~30m hear three muffled deliberate-seeming knocks from within second wagon followed by pause, repeated once. One escort rests hand against vehicle side and sounds stop; unknown cause, may be human but not proven. Woman document escort turns sharply and grips file folder hard, steps between customs worker and wagon2. Another armed escort subtly positions body near rear door when customs officer moves toward it. No attack or exposed weapon.
Jun turns to Shiki and asks 'Это вы тоже слышали?', remains alert awaiting field lead's decision. Customs officer still asking medical paperwork, covered wagon2 not opened.

scene.event_gate: At 17:27 inspection is ongoing; Kusa clerk has not yet opened wagon2; woman blocking him and guard covers rear of wagon, repeated knocks had sounded. No armed conflict yet.
scene.options_examples: Observe longer, ask Jun coordinated ordinary check, personally approach legally, use sensory technique, attempt covert infiltration, shadow convoy, or any other player action. No forced listed choice.
